name: Hamstringer

passives.name: Scour
passives.effects: Critical strikes inflict a bleed on the target for 2 seconds, dealing bonus physical damage equal to 5 – 20 (based on level) plus 6.25% of the pre-mitigation critical strike instance every 0.5 seconds, as well as applies a 7% slow for the same duration. The bleed's damage is affected by critical strike modifiers and stacks infinitely; the slow stacks up to 35%.
